استوضحن (form X)
# اِسْتَوْضَحْنَ (istawḍaḥna) /is.taw.dˤaħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اُسْتُوضِحْنَ (ustūḍiḥna) /us.tuː.dˤiħ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
# اِسْتَوْضِحْنَ (istawḍiḥna) /is.taw.dˤiħ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَوْضَحَ (istawḍaḥa)
